messages:
anya: Quick sync — can we lock the GA acceptance checklist for Private Deployment next quarter? Need explicit owners for SLA wording, docs, support staffing, monitoring SLOs/runbooks, and pricing page updates. Who can take which piece? :spiral_calendar_pad:

olivia: I can own the docs drafts + runbook templates. Will need concrete SLA numbers and examples to write customer-facing language.

sam: I can own feasibility for runtime SLAs. Quick ask: are we targeting p99 latency or p95? Also need to confirm model variants that will be GA-covered.

anya: Good call. Proposal: SLA tiers — Bronze (best-effort), Silver (p95 <= 300ms, 99.0% availability), Gold (p95 <= 150ms, 99.9% availability). Can you validate, @sam?

sam: Rough check: Gold at 150ms p95 is realistic in hosted env with dedicated GPUs but not for every private on-prem config. For Private (VPC/on-prem) we should provide SLA guidance + platform-assisted deployment checklist instead of hard SLA for all installs. Recommend:
```
- Hosted: Gold/Silver/Bronze as above (we can commit)
- Dedicated: Silver by default, Gold for reserved configs (GPUs+, network reqs)
- Private: No platform SLA; provide recommended SLOs + deployment verification runbook
```

nate: For monitoring & SLOs I can add: 1) default dashboards, 2) alerting for latency/error-rate, 3) synthetic traffic tests and reporting. Need to decide alert thresholds.

kevin: Support staffing: if Gold SLA accepted we need 24/7 on-call handoff model for dedicated customers. We should define escalation matrix and an SLA credit process. I can draft an incident playbook for GA customers.

lisa: Pricing: we need to add a Gold premium for SLA-backed Dedicated, and a Professional Services line for Private installs (installation + runbook verification). Can we agree on preliminary bands before sales deck update?

anya: Action items and owners (deadline EOD next Tue):
- SLA language + exceptions: @sam (tech validation) + @anya (copy)
- Docs: GA doc set + runbook + FAQ: @olivia
- Monitoring templates + dashboards: @nate
- Support playbook + escalation: @kevin
- Pricing tiers + PS scope: @lisa
- Legal review hooks (compliance/KMS): I'll ping legal after these drafts.

olivia: Will start doc skeleton. One ask: can engineering provide sample monitoring query names and example alerts (e.g., `error_rate > 1% over 5m`) — speeds up writing.

sam: Will paste sample queries and a minimal config snippet tomorrow. Example: `alert if p95_latency > 300ms for 5m` and a required network policy snippet for on-prem.

kevin: Also propose: dedicated customers get a 2-week warm-handoff training and a named CSM for the first 90 days. I'll scope staffing impact.

lisa: For pricing bands, I'll propose ranges and margin targets; we can iterate.

anya: Thanks — let's treat this thread as the canonical action tracker for this slice. If anyone can't meet the deadline, shout now. Otherwise I'll compile the draft SLA + checklist once I have each deliverable. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: private-deployments-ga-review meeting added to calendar Thu 10:00am PT — attendees: anya, sam, olivia, nate, kevin, lisa.

sam: FYI — I'll include a short paragraph in the runtime doc about fallback policies (model variant routing) and cost/perf tradeoffs to justify SLA exceptions.

anya: Perfect. Closing for now — I’ll create a PR in the product repo linking docs + SLA draft when items are in.

kevin: one more: add support SLAs to the public pricing page (what's covered vs. add-on). I'll draft copy for product review.

olivia: noted. I'll create a `/docs/ga/private-deployments/` folder and add an index + runbook template.

anya: Great work — low churn but clear owners. We’ll reconvene after deliverables.
